comments.text: Why isn't the Government of Hong Kong do something akin to Singapore? Why keep so much reserves?

replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: Singapore created the CPF forced-savings system and acquired roughly 90% of its land to build universal HDB flats, whereas Hong Kong relies heavily on property auctions to avoid charging sales or capital gains taxes. As for the reserves, Hong Kong keeps them extraordinarily high as a financial shield to protect its currency peg and weather global economic shocks without taking on debt.
